name: VENUS Wrestling Alliance B1TCHIN': 12.30.06!

date.source: the page's own date line, 12.30.06 (the page carries no TAPED or AIRED field); the mirror's own folder for this card is numbered 40. The date is the card's own in-fiction one: the fed's own forum shows the same four matches as B1TCHIN' 00 still being written on 3 January 2007, and its main event not yet written on 16 February 2007.

matches.note: Candy Carmichael wins her first match at 8:32 with the Tastes Like Candy running sitdown powerbomb. Brandon Jacobs accompanies Carlee Marx.
Victoria Hawke wins her VENUS debut at 13:44 with the I Tiden frog splash.
Both women are counted out at 5:44 after brawling over the top rope, and the ring announcer rules it a draw.
Karla Starr retains at 22:20 with the Morning Starr, a top-rope moonsault, in the first defense of the newly christened title.

notes: The VENUS Wrestling Alliance's preview showcase, opening with a grainy replay of the 19 December RAUCOUS in which the New ERA Women's Heavyweight Championship belt crumbles and a VENUS World Heavyweight Championship belt appears. Jason Tripp and Natalie Newman call four matches, with Jamie Links as ring announcer: Candy Carmichael debuts with a win over Carlee Marx, Victoria Hawke beats Krist Blue, Caitlyn Daymon and Felicia Hart draw, and Karla Starr retains the title against Foxx.
